title: Liber LXXVIII: A Description of the Cards of the Tarot
edition: The Equinox I:8 (1912), published by Aleister Crowley; transmits Book T material
locator: Titles, decan table, twenty-two keys and descriptions of the Aces
note: A published witness to GD-derived material, not a claim that every editorial detail is an original Order instruction. Its Fortitude XI / Justice VIII numbering is not universal across GD presentations.

title: Liber 777
edition: 1909 tables, as reproduced in online transcription
locator: Table I, columns II, III, V–VII and XIV; Table IV, columns XCIX–CI; Table VI, Tarot attributions. The four-world teaching convention is separately explained in the Sephirah notes.
note: Crowley’s compilation of inherited and expanded correspondences. It is not a neutral record of all Jewish Kabbalah. Later editorial additions must be distinguished.

title: The Book of Thoth
locator: Part II: individual trump essays; Part III: small cards; appendix attribution tables
note: Card-essay attributions are used for Emperor/Star comparisons. Interpretive text in this app is a study paraphrase, not a quotation. No deck artwork is reproduced.

tradition: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn / published Golden Dawn manuscript material
title: Manuscript Q — Key to Tarot Divination
edition: Golden Dawn manuscript material preserved in later published collections and transcriptions
locator: Manuscript Q: Key to Tarot Divination; Opening of the Key; First through Fifth Operations
note: Baseline source used here for the five-operation Opening of the Key procedure, Significator method, card counting, packet selection and pairing. House teaching summaries and application prompts are separately identified as modern educational synthesis.

title: Gnosis study prompts
locator: Basic explanations, derivation prompts, House summaries and learning exercises
note: Original educational synthesis; not a historical quotation or a scientific claim.

tradition: R. G. Torrens / published Golden Dawn-derived material
